# TakeMockTest

> TakeMockTest is a free, no-login mock-test platform for Indian competitive exam aspirants. It offers syllabus-checked practice tests with instant scoring, negative marking, section-wise and topic-wise result analysis, and a growing catalog of ~180 Indian competitive exams (government jobs, engineering, medical, banking, defence, teaching, and more).

Every checked question includes a source record (official notification/syllabus reference, URL, and the date it was verified) — no fabricated or "leaked paper" claims. Results and progress are stored only on the visitor's own device (localStorage); there is no account system and no server-side tracking of attempts.

## Mock tests with live, syllabus-checked content

- [SSC CGL](https://takemocktest.com/in/ssc-cgl/mock-test): Tier 1 (3 full mocks, sectional tests, plus quick timed tests, difficulty-tiered practice, and topic drills — 45 tests total) and Tier 2 Paper 1 Objective (3 full mocks + sectional tests)
- [SSC CHSL](https://takemocktest.com/in/ssc-chsl/mock-test): Tier 1 (1 full mock + 4 sectional tests), single 60-minute combined timer, qualifying stage only
- [IBPS PO](https://takemocktest.com/in/ibps-po/mock-test): Prelims (1 full mock + sectional tests) and Mains (1 full mock covering the 170 objective questions + 4 sectional tests; the Descriptive Paper is excluded as it is not multiple-choice)
- [IBPS Clerk](https://takemocktest.com/in/ibps-clerk/mock-test): Prelims (1 full mock + 3 sectional tests), 20-minute sectional timers, qualifying stage only — Mains marks decide the final merit list
- [RRB NTPC](https://takemocktest.com/in/rrb-ntpc/mock-test): CBT 1 (1 full mock + 3 sectional tests), single 90-minute combined timer, qualifying stage only
- [RRB Group D](https://takemocktest.com/in/rrb-group-d/mock-test): CBT (1 full mock + 4 sectional tests), single 90-minute combined timer, followed by a non-written Physical Efficiency Test
- [SBI PO](https://takemocktest.com/in/sbi-po/mock-test): Prelims (1 full mock + 3 sectional tests), 20-minute sectional timers, qualifying stage only — Mains marks decide the final merit list
- [RBI Assistant](https://takemocktest.com/in/rbi-assistant/mock-test): Prelims (1 full mock + 3 sectional tests), 20-minute sectional timers, qualifying stage only — Mains marks decide the final merit list
- [SSC MTS & Havaldar](https://takemocktest.com/in/ssc-mts/mock-test): CBT (1 full mock + 4 sectional tests + 2 quick timed tests), two-session format — no negative marking in Session 1 (Numerical/Reasoning), 1 mark deducted per wrong answer in Session 2 (General Awareness/English)
- [IBPS RRB Office Assistant](https://takemocktest.com/in/ibps-rrb-office-assistant/mock-test): Prelims (1 full mock + 2 sectional tests + 2 quick timed tests), single 45-minute combined timer (no sectional lock), qualifying stage only — Mains marks decide the final merit list
- [SSC GD Constable](https://takemocktest.com/in/ssc-gd-constable/mock-test): CBE (1 full mock + 4 sectional tests + 2 quick timed tests), single 60-minute combined timer, Matriculation-level questions, followed by a non-written PET/PST, medical exam, and document verification
- [IBPS RRB Officer Scale I](https://takemocktest.com/in/ibps-rrb-officer-scale-1/mock-test): Prelims (1 full mock + 2 sectional tests + 2 quick timed tests), single 45-minute combined timer (no sectional lock), qualifying stage only — graduate-entry officer-level difficulty, higher than the IBPS RRB Office Assistant mock on this site
- [SBI Clerk](https://takemocktest.com/in/sbi-clerk/mock-test): Prelims (1 full mock + 3 sectional tests + 2 quick timed tests), 3 separately-timed 20-minute sections (English Language, Numerical Ability, Reasoning Ability) — sectional lock, not a combined timer — qualifying stage only, Mains marks decide the final merit list
- [RRB Junior Engineer / DMS / CMA](https://takemocktest.com/in/rrb-je/mock-test): CBT 1 (1 full mock + 4 sectional tests), single 90-minute combined timer, common screening stage only — branch-specific CBT 2 decides the final merit list
- [UPSC Civil Services Preliminary](https://takemocktest.com/in/upsc-cse/mock-test): GS Paper I (1 full mock + 7 sectional tests, 100Q/200 marks/120 min) and CSAT Paper II (1 full mock + 6 sectional tests, 80Q/200 marks/120 min, qualifying only at 33%) — both single-timer papers with no sectional lock
- [RPF Constable](https://takemocktest.com/in/rpf-constable/mock-test): CBT (1 full mock + 3 sectional tests, 120Q/120 marks/90 min), single combined timer, 1/3 negative marking, followed by a non-written PET/PMT, document verification, and medical examination
- [SSC CPO](https://takemocktest.com/in/ssc-cpo/mock-test): Paper 1 (1 full mock + 4 sectional tests, 200Q/200 marks/120 min), sectional lock — each of the four sections has its own separately timed 30-minute window, 1/4 negative marking, followed by PST/PET, Paper 2 (English), and a medical examination
- [IBPS SO](https://takemocktest.com/in/ibps-so/mock-test): Prelims (1 full mock + 3 sectional tests, 150Q/125 marks/120 min) for IT Officer, Agriculture Field Officer, HR/Personnel Officer, and Marketing Officer (Scale I) — sectional lock with three separately timed 40-minute sections; English Language questions carry 0.5 marks each while Reasoning and Quantitative Aptitude carry 1 mark each; qualifying stage only, Mains (Professional Knowledge) marks decide the final merit list
- [RBI Grade B](https://takemocktest.com/in/rbi-grade-b/mock-test): Phase I (1 full mock + 4 sectional tests, 200Q/200 marks/120 min) for the General cadre — sectional lock with four separately timed windows (25/25/25/45 min), 1/4 negative marking; qualifying stage only, Phase II (Economic and Social Issues, English Writing Skills, Finance and Management) and interview decide the final merit list
- [NABARD Grade A](https://takemocktest.com/in/nabard-grade-a/mock-test): Phase I (1 full mock + 8 sectional tests, 200Q/200 marks/120 min) for the RDBS (General) cadre — single composite 120-minute timer across all eight sections, no sectional lock, 1/4 negative marking; Reasoning, English Language, Computer Knowledge, Quantitative Aptitude, and Decision Making are qualifying only, while General Awareness, Economic and Social Issues, and Agriculture and Rural Development form the merit section that decides Phase II (Mains) shortlisting
- [SEBI Grade A](https://takemocktest.com/in/sebi-grade-a/mock-test): Phase I for the General stream, modelled as two separately-timed papers — Paper 1 (1 full mock + 4 sectional tests, 80Q/100 marks/60 min: General Awareness, English Language, Quantitative Aptitude, Test of Reasoning) and Paper 2 (1 full mock + 7 sectional tests, 50Q/100 marks/40 min: Commerce, Accountancy, Management, Finance, Costing, Companies Act, Economics) — each paper uses its own composite timer with no sectional lock, 1/4 negative marking (1.25 marks/question in Paper 1, 2 marks/question in Paper 2)
- [SIDBI Grade A & B](https://takemocktest.com/in/sidbi-grade-a-b/mock-test): Phase I for the General stream (1 full mock + 7 sectional tests, 200Q/200 marks/120 min) — single composite 120-minute timer across all seven sections, no sectional lock, 1/4 negative marking; English Language, Reasoning Aptitude, Quantitative Aptitude, and Computer Knowledge are qualifying only, while General Awareness, MSMEs Policy/Finance/Management, and the Stream Specific Test form the 100-mark merit section that decides Phase II shortlisting
- [LIC AAO](https://takemocktest.com/in/lic-aao/mock-test): Prelims (1 full mock + 3 sectional tests, 100Q/100 marks/60 min) — sectional lock with three separately timed 20-minute windows (Reasoning Ability, Quantitative Aptitude, English Language), zero negative marking; English Language is scored but qualifying only, so only the 70 marks from Reasoning Ability and Quantitative Aptitude decide who advances to Mains
- [NIACL AO](https://takemocktest.com/in/niacl-ao/mock-test): Prelims (1 full mock + 3 sectional tests, 100Q/100 marks/60 min) and Mains (1 full mock + 4 sectional tests, 200Q/200 marks/150 min) for the Administrative Officer (Generalist) role — both stages use sectional lock, 1/4 negative marking; Prelims is qualifying only and used to shortlist for Mains, while Mains' Descriptive Test (Letter Writing and Essay) is excluded as it is not multiple-choice; final selection is decided by the Mains objective score plus interview
- [RRB ALP](https://takemocktest.com/in/rrb-alp/mock-test): CBT 1 (1 full mock + 4 sectional tests, 75Q/75 marks/60 min, screening only) and CBT 2 Part A (1 full mock + 3 sectional tests, 100Q/100 marks/90 min) for Assistant Loco Pilot — both stages use a single composite timer per stage (no sectional lock), 1/3 negative marking; CBT 2 Part B (trade-specific, varies by candidate) and the Computer Based Aptitude Test (a psychometric battery) are excluded since they cannot be modeled as a common-syllabus MCQ mock; final merit is 70% Part A of CBT 2 plus 30% CBAT score
- [RRB Technician](https://takemocktest.com/in/rrb-technician/mock-test): Grade I Signal CBT (1 full mock + 5 sectional tests, 100Q/100 marks/90 min) and Grade III CBT (1 full mock + 4 sectional tests, 100Q/100 marks/90 min) — each pay level has a single CBT that directly decides shortlisting for Document Verification (no second-stage CBT, no skill test), single composite timer per stage (no sectional lock), 1/3 negative marking
- [RRB Paramedical Categories](https://takemocktest.com/in/rrb-paramedical/mock-test): single CBT (3 sectional tests only, no full mock), covering General Awareness (10Q), General Arithmetic and General Intelligence and Reasoning (10Q, combined into one section as per the official pattern), and General Science (10Q). Professional Ability, 70 of the 100 questions, is excluded: it varies by post (Staff Nurse, Pharmacist, Laboratory Assistant, Radiographer, ECG Technician, and others), so there is no single common syllabus that would be accurate for every candidate. This is the only exam on this site without a full-length mock, and the exclusion is stated on the exam page. Single CBT directly decides Document Verification shortlisting; 1/3 negative marking
- [RPF Sub-Inspector](https://takemocktest.com/in/rpf-si/mock-test): CBT (1 full mock + 3 sectional tests, 120Q/120 marks/90 min), single composite timer (no sectional lock), 1/3 negative marking, graduation-level questions. Same section structure as RPF Constable on this site (Arithmetic, General Intelligence and Reasoning, General Awareness) but a distinct question bank, since RPF SI is set at graduation level while RPF Constable is not. Minimum pass percentage: UR, EWS and OBC-NCL 35%, SC and ST 30%. Single CBT directly decides shortlisting for a qualifying-only PET/PMT, followed by Document Verification
- [SSC Junior Engineer](https://takemocktest.com/in/ssc-je/mock-test): Paper I (1 full mock + 2 sectional tests, 100Q/100 marks/120 min), single composite timer (no sectional lock), 0.25 negative marking. Paper I covers only General Intelligence and Reasoning (50Q) and General Awareness (50Q), common to every candidate regardless of engineering discipline. Paper II, the discipline-specific General Engineering paper (100Q/300 marks, varies by Civil, Electrical, or Mechanical stream), is excluded since no single question bank would suit every candidate, but note that Paper II is fully objective and multiple-choice too, not descriptive as some secondary sources describe it; both papers' normalized scores together decide the final merit list
- [SSC Stenographer Grade C & D](https://takemocktest.com/in/ssc-steno/mock-test): Computer Based Examination (1 full mock + 3 sectional tests, 200Q/200 marks/120 min), single composite timer (no sectional lock), 0.25 negative marking, covering General Intelligence and Reasoning (50Q), General Awareness (50Q), and English Language and Comprehension (100Q). The Stenography Skill Test (a 10-minute dictation and transcription exercise at 100 WPM for Grade C or 80 WPM for Grade D) is excluded since it is not a multiple-choice format; normalized CBT scores decide the Skill Test shortlist and final merit
- [SSC Combined Hindi Translators](https://takemocktest.com/in/ssc-cht/mock-test): Paper I (1 full mock, 2 sectional tests, and 3 quick tests, 200Q/200 marks/120 min), separate 60-minute timers for General Hindi (100Q) and General English (100Q), with 0.25 negative marking. Paper II is a 200-mark descriptive translation and essay paper and is not modeled in the MCQ interface
- [SSC Selection Post](https://takemocktest.com/in/ssc-selection-post/mock-test): Phase XIV/2026 CBEs for Matriculation, Higher Secondary (10+2), and Graduation and Above posts. Each level has 1 full mock, 4 sectional tests, and 2 quick tests, with 100Q/200 marks/60 min, four separately timed 15-minute parts, and 0.50 negative marking. Post-specific qualifying skill tests are not included
- [BITSAT](https://takemocktest.com/in/bitsat/mock-test): 2026 Mathematics variant Full Mock 1, with the standard 130 questions for 390 marks in 180 minutes under one composite timer and no sectional lock. Physics has 30 questions, Chemistry 30, English Proficiency 10, Logical Reasoning 20, and Mathematics 40; correct answers earn +3, incorrect answers deduct 1, and unattempted questions score zero. The optional 12 extra questions are not included
- [JEE Main](https://takemocktest.com/in/jee-main/mock-test): 2026 Paper 1 for B.E. and B.Tech. admission (1 full mock, 3 sectional tests, and 2 mixed quick tests), 75Q/300 marks/180 min under one combined timer. Mathematics, Physics, and Chemistry each contain 20 MCQs plus 5 numerical-value questions, with +4 for a correct answer and -1 for an incorrect answer in both formats
- [JEE Advanced](https://takemocktest.com/in/jee-advanced/mock-test): 2026 Paper 1 (48Q/180 marks/180 min) and Paper 2 (54Q/180 marks/180 min), each with 1 full mock and 3 subject sectionals. Both papers use single-correct, multi-select with partial marking, and numerical-value formats; both official papers are compulsory
- [VITEEE](https://takemocktest.com/in/viteee/mock-test): 2026 MPCEA Mathematics stream (1 full mock, 5 sectional tests, and 2 mixed quick tests), 125Q/500 marks/150 min under one combined timer. Mathematics 40, Physics 35, Chemistry 35, Aptitude 10, English 5; +4 for a correct answer and -1 for an incorrect answer, a change from the no-negative-marking rule used in 2025. Sectional and quick-practice timers are TakeMockTest-defined, not official VITEEE sectional timings. BPCEA (Biology stream) is not covered
- [SRMJEEE](https://takemocktest.com/in/srmjeee/mock-test): 2026 PCM Mathematics route (1 full mock, 4 sectional tests, and 2 mixed quick tests), 130Q/130 marks/150 min under one combined timer. Physics 35, Chemistry 35, Mathematics 40, English & Aptitude 20; +1 for a correct answer and no negative marking. Sectional and quick-practice timers are TakeMockTest-defined, not official SRMJEEE sectional timings. The Mathematics/Biology route is not covered
- [AEEE](https://takemocktest.com/in/aeee/mock-test): 2026 B.Tech (1 full mock, 5 sectional tests, and 2 mixed quick tests), 100Q/300 marks/150 min under one combined timer. Mathematics 40, Physics 25, Chemistry 20, Quantitative Aptitude 10, English 5; +3 for a correct answer and -1 for an incorrect answer. Sectional and quick-practice timers are TakeMockTest-defined, not official AEEE sectional timings

## Exam information pages

Each of the exams above also has dedicated pages for exam pattern, syllabus, eligibility, selection process, admit card, answer key, result, cutoff, salary, and previous year papers, e.g. [SSC CGL exam pattern](https://takemocktest.com/in/ssc-cgl/exam-pattern).

## Exam catalog

[Browse all ~180 exams by category](https://takemocktest.com/in/exams) — Government Jobs, Engineering, Medical, Study Abroad, Management, University & Science, Defence, Law, Teaching, Commerce, and Design/Hospitality. Most catalog entries link to official government sources; only the exams listed above currently have live mock tests on this site.

## Study resources

[Blog](https://takemocktest.com/in/blog): original, evergreen exam-prep articles, each with an FAQ section and internal links to the relevant exam pages. Covers building a study timetable, common SSC CGL mistakes, how negative marking works, exam-time time management, analyzing your mock-test performance, IBPS PO vs SSC CGL, sectional lock vs composite timer, qualifying vs merit sections in bank exams, a beginner's guide to banking exams in India, SSC vs Banking vs Railways, and RBI Grade B vs NABARD vs SEBI vs SIDBI.
